en: A colorized historical postcard showing a large monument to Dante Alighieri in an open square, with mountains in the background. The multi-tiered pedestal is decorated with reliefs and statues, topped by a standing figure of Dante with one arm raised. At the base are additional allegorical figures, including a winged lion. A bell tower and buildings are visible behind trees, and several people in early 20th‑century clothing stand around the monument. The words 'Trento' and 'Monumento a Dante' are printed at the top.
